ROUTE_A.route_name: Company-Led Operating Model Inflection & Transition to Self-Funding
ROUTE_A.hypothesis: Operating commercial enterprises transitioning from cash-burning clinical/hardware development to turnkey recurring service models achieve inflection in free cash flow per share that consensus models often lag.

ROUTE_B.route_name: Industry-Led Value-Chain Constraint Tracing (High-Voltage Grid Bottleneck)
ROUTE_B.hypothesis: Hyperscale AI data center construction is constrained by electrical utility interconnection lead times and high-voltage substation switchgear shortages, directly benefiting entrenched electrical power equipment manufacturers.

discovery_provenance.screening_basis: Inflection to positive GAAP net income and operating cash flow driven by National OCS Program (NOP) dedicated aviation logistics.

observable_development.timing_and_baseline: FY2025 revenue reached $605.5M (+37.1% YoY vs $441.5M in FY2024 and $241.6M in FY2023). 1H 2026 sustained momentum with Q2 2026 revenue of $189.9M (+21% YoY) and GAAP net income of $14.7M.
observable_development.primary_filing_evidence: Form 10-K FY2025 for period ended December 31, 2025, filed February 24, 2026 (CIK: 0001756262, Accession: 0001193125-26-067032, https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1756262/000119312526067032/tmdx-20251231.htm); Form 10-Q Q2 2026 filed August 4, 2026 (Accession: 0001193125-26-284200, https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1756262/000119312526284200/tmdx-20260630.htm).

value_capture.competitive_moat: FDA-approved multi-organ warm machine perfusion platform (OCS Heart, Lung, Liver) integrated with dedicated National OCS Program aviation logistics network, creating high transplant center switching costs.
value_capture.capex_and_reinvestment: Growth capex of $58.0M in FY25 reflects owned aircraft fleet buildout to guarantee mission reliability.
value_capture.dilution_and_sbc: FY2025 stock-based compensation was $44.5M (7.3% of revenue).

price_and_expectations.market_pricing_context: valuation/expectation gap unresolved (dated market multiple and consensus expectations not independently established via primary broker feeds; unresolved expectations are not used as an established reason to alter queue priority)

expectation_disaggregation.company_guidance: Management targets continued double-digit procedural expansion and European aviation integration via PAD Aviation
expectation_disaggregation.sourced_analyst_consensus: UNRESOLVED_CONSENSUS (Primary broker consensus data not accessible in current environment)
expectation_disaggregation.reverse_dcf_solved_condition: High volume expansion across US donor pools required to support current multiple; sensitive to aviation operating leverage

downside_and_survival.solvency_assessment: Liquid balance sheet with net cash headroom of $22.7M; convertible notes mature in 2028.

disconfirmation_criteria: Consolidated gross margin contraction below 58.0% indicating severe aviation cost escalation
FAA safety grounding or regulatory disruption affecting NOP flight operations
US organ perfusion procedure volume growth decelerating below 10.0% YoY

research_priority.rationale: Compelling operating model turnaround with positive FCF generation and net cash liquidity. Retained internally for European aviation tracking without public Quality Watch selection.

discovery_provenance.screening_basis: Market leadership in electrical distribution and switchgear addressing multi-year datacenter high-voltage substation interconnection bottleneck.

observable_development.timing_and_baseline: FY2025 net sales reached $27,400.0M (+10.0% YoY, 8% organic). Electrical Americas segment margin expanded to record 28.4% on massive datacenter megaproject backlog extending past 2028.
observable_development.primary_filing_evidence: Form 10-K FY2025 for period ended December 31, 2025, filed February 25, 2026 (CIK: 0001551179, Accession: 0001551179-26-000011, https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1551179/000155117926000011/etn-20251231.htm); Form 10-Q Q2 2026 filed August 4, 2026 (Accession: 0001551179-26-000055, https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1551179/000155117926000055/etn-20260630.htm).

value_capture.competitive_moat: Entrenched engineering specification and contractor distribution moat across high-voltage switchgear, medium-voltage distribution transformers, and UPS lineups.
value_capture.capex_and_reinvestment: Low capex intensity (3.0% of revenue) enables 82% FCF conversion to fund steady share repurchases and dividends.
value_capture.dilution_and_sbc: Minimal dilution; ongoing share buyback program more than offsets executive stock compensation.

price_and_expectations.market_pricing_context: valuation/expectation gap unresolved (dated market multiple and consensus expectations not independently established via primary broker feeds; unresolved expectations are not used as an established reason to alter queue priority)

expectation_disaggregation.company_guidance: Management targets above-GDP organic compounding through 2028 supported by electrical super-cycle megaproject backlog
expectation_disaggregation.sourced_analyst_consensus: UNRESOLVED_CONSENSUS (Primary broker consensus data not accessible in current environment)
expectation_disaggregation.reverse_dcf_solved_condition: Valuation embeds expectations of sustained double-digit electrical segment operating profit growth

downside_and_survival.solvency_assessment: Investment-grade balance sheet ('A-' / 'A3') with >14x interest coverage and staggered multi-decade debt maturities.

disconfirmation_criteria: Electrical Americas book-to-bill falling below 0.95x indicating megaproject order cancellations
Electrical Americas segment operating margins contracting below 24.0%
FCF / CFO conversion dropping below 70.0% due to unabsorbed fixed capacity

research_priority.rationale: Premier upstream electrical infrastructure enabler with 82% FCF conversion and record megaproject backlog. Advanced to the top of prospective Quality Watch candidate queue.
